headline: World Bank Raises Kenya 2026 Growth Forecast, Urges Graft Curb
summary: The World Bank raised its 2026 economic growth forecast for Kenya while urging the government to curb corruption to sustain development.
why: Multilateral lender forecasts and governance recommendations influence sovereign debt ratings and foreign direct investment sentiment in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: An upgraded growth forecast signals improved macroeconomic prospects for the country.
